prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait, vertical portrait-orientation. ONE woman, facing the camera in a frontal view, framed from the very top of her head down to the base of her neck and collarbones, the frame cutting off there. Her face is large and sharp. Mid 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Polish woman, mid 20s, with a streetwise skater-girl heroine look brought to life, with messy platinum-blonde hair in a short bob with two bright red streaks. Her complexion is a fair porcelain with a light flush, each strand real hair with natural shine, fine flyaways and a few loose wisps. Her eyes are huge, perfectly round eyes with an enormous visible iris in bright green contact lenses with a darker limbal ring and a round natural pupil, one large bright catchlight and one small catchlight in each iris, a thick drawn lower lash line, long dark lashes, a bold red graphic liner and a silver shimmer on the lids, under thin, high, simple brows, with real wet eyes and real eyelid skin around them, the eyes taking up nearly half the width of her face in exaggerated anime proportion, set slightly wider apart than normal, with a crisp dark double-eyelid line and a faint luminous ring of light in each iris. Her lips are full and glossy, in a bold red gradient, deeper in the centre and fading at the edges, curved into a cheeky smile. A deep warm-pink blush spreads over both cheeks and across the tip of the nose. A tiny nose reduced to a small soft rounded tip with a tiny highlight and a faint shade beneath it, the bridge and nostrils barely visible, a very small simple mouth with the corners lifted slightly, a small pointed chin, and a softly narrowed anime face shape. A cheeky, bold, wide-eyed gaze. Her skin, across her face, neck and shoulders, is real human skin with visible fine pores across the nose and cheeks, a few tiny freckles and small beauty marks on her face, shoulders and collarbones, a faint uneven warmth with a pink flush on the cheeks and the tip of the nose, a soft shadow under the eyes, fine natural lines at the corners of the eyes and lips, a light natural sheen on the nose, forehead and collarbones, and the rest of her skin in a soft natural matte finish, real living flesh with warmth. She is a professional cosplayer in a flawless cosplay transformation: large circle lenses, thick false lashes with drawn lower lashes, eyelid tape for a wide double lid, contouring that shrinks the nose and sharpens the chin, and a high-quality wig with a natural hairline and real-looking strands. Jewelry: on each ear, four separate heavy ear weights of real bright satin tin hanging from a polished silver ring through the lobe, each on its own silver chain of a different length so they hang staggered at different heights and fully visible side by side: on the left ear a square-sided cowbell, a pyramid-shaped lump, a chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a bell-shaped weight like a small temple bell with a flared rim; on the right ear a ship's anchor, a barrel-shaped weight, a round bell, a hammer head. Every weight is a dense, solid, heavy, satin-finished lump of silvery tin about the size of a large walnut, hanging freely in the air with the longest weight ending at the level of her collarbones, and their weight gently pulls each earlobe down into a soft, slightly elongated, healthy loop of smooth skin. At her neck she wears real layered silver chains of different lengths resting on her collarbones. Pose: head tilted, one hand pushing back her bangs.

Background: a softly blurred skate park with graffiti walls and warm sunset bokeh.

Lighting: bright, soft, even light across the face with only gentle shading, and a thin rim light along the hair and shoulders. Shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/4, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. 8K vertical portrait-orientation 3:4 aspect ratio.
